name: Audio Server & Control Utilities
shortDesc: Next-gen low-latency multimedia routing engine, volume GUI, and parametric equalizers.
detailedDesc: PipeWire replaces PulseAudio and JACK with professional low-latency routing.

phase.title: Audio, Hardware & Connectivity
phase.description: PipeWire audio stack, Bluetooth, NetworkManager, screen brightness, and power management.

packages.name: PipeWire + WirePlumber (Recommended Core)
packages.description: Modern multimedia daemon with ALSA, PulseAudio, and JACK compatibility layers, managed by WirePlumber policy engine.

packages.name: Pavucontrol (GTK Volume GUI) (Recommended)
packages.description: Standard PulseAudio/PipeWire volume control GUI for per-application audio routing and device switching.

packages.name: pwvucontrol
packages.description: Native PipeWire volume control written in Rust and GTK4 with responsive VU meters.

packages.name: EasyEffects
packages.description: Advanced audio effects, equalizers, noise reduction, and compressors for PipeWire.
cons: Higher CPU usage when multiple DSP plugins are active

packages.name: wiremix (TUI PipeWire Mixer)
packages.description: Terminal user interface for PipeWire audio routing and volume levels.
pros: Keyboard driven mixer inside your terminal
